data.title: Bleu Garde Announces Landmark EPA Registration for Arresta® at Builds Bio+ Philadelphia Life Science Symposium
data.description: Philadelphia-based company Bleu Garde, LLC unveiled their breakthrough indoor air treatment technology, Arresta®, at the Builds Bio+ 5th Annual Philadelphia Life Science Symposium. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has officially registered Arresta® as a virucidal air treatment, air sanitizer, and fungistat. This registration enables its use in occupied indoor spaces, marking a significant advancement in pathogen reduction, environmental health, and pandemic preparedness efforts.

data.title: GuidePoint Security Expands Identity and Access Management Practice With Three New Service Offerings
data.description: Reston, Virginia - GuidePoint Security has announced the expansion of its Identity and Access Management Practice through the introduction of new services including Agentic AI, Identity Verification, and Non-human Identity solutions. This initiative aims to enhance the company's capabilities in providing advanced security services.

data.title: Ordr Appoints Jamie Chaplin as Vice President of Payment Solutions
data.description: Ordr, a company specializing in commerce intelligence for live experiences, has named Jamie Chaplin as the new Vice President of Payment Solutions. In her role, Chaplin will oversee the strategic development of Ordr Pay, the payment component of the Ordr platform, which includes merchant processing, virtual payments, agentic payments, and alternative payments. With close to twenty years of experience in payments and commerce technology, Chaplin previously served at Olo for six years.

data.title: Polaris Electro-Optics Secures $50M Series B to Scale Next-Gen Optical Engine Platform for AI Infrastructure
data.description: A company based in Carlsbad, California, Polaris Electro-Optics, Inc., shared news today of securing $50 million in fresh funding to advance its FenGlass™ electro-optic modulator platform toward production. Notable investors in this funding round include Walden Catalyst Ventures as the lead, along with new contributors Socratic Partners, Cambium Capital, Knollwood, and Hudson River Trading, as well as existing investors Koch Disruptive Technologies, M Ventures, Rhapsody Venture Partners, Buff Gold Ventures, and Blue Sky Capital. Andy Kau, a Partner at Walden Catalyst Ventures, played a significant role in this funding round.
